summary: QCR Holdings filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend increase from $0.10 to $0.15 per share, declared on August 20, 2026, payable October 5, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 18, 2026. This is an ordinary capital return event, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics apply. The filing includes a press release and standard exhibits. What to watch: future dividend policy and earnings performance, but no risk-arb angle.
